sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: Sydney Metro requires an organisation to provide approximately 1300 Kg of native seed (composed of numerous species, including storage, testing, quality reporting, and monitoring of shelf life.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The Service Provider is responsible for coordinating the supply and management of native and endemic seed resources, including the processing, storage and testing of procured seed for the Principal in respect of the Project.
The Service Provider is to procure, preserve and safeguard a supply of native and endemic seeds to be used for ecological restoration and biodiversity enhancement within and adjacent to the project area as part of Corridor Restoration Works (CRW).
The Service Provider will undertake seed procurement activities, including the planning, sourcing and management of the seed resource. Seeds are to be procured and stored on behalf of the Principal to be used in Corridor Restoration Works from 2028, or as determined by the Principal.
